title: Second Benchmark Specification — LedgerFlow Lite
projectDescription: A small invoicing/expense system. Users create customers/vendors, generate invoices with line items, submit for approval, track status through an approval workflow, and view dashboard summaries. Includes CSV export.

FR01.name: User Registration and Authentication
FR01.description: Users register with email+password. Login returns JWT. bcrypt password hashing.

FR02.name: Role-Based Access Control
FR02.description: Roles: admin, manager, clerk, viewer. Admin manages users. Permissions enforced server-side.

FR03.name: Customer/Vendor Management
FR03.description: CRUD for customers/vendors with name, email, address, phone. Scoped to organization.

FR04.name: Invoice CRUD with Line Items
FR04.description: Create invoices with multiple line items. Each line item: description, quantity, unit_price. Auto-calculate line_total, subtotal, tax, grand_total.

FR05.name: Financial Calculation Correctness
FR05.description: line_total = quantity * unit_price. subtotal = sum(line_totals). tax = subtotal * tax_rate. grand_total = subtotal + tax. All server-side calculated.

FR06.name: Approval Workflow
FR06.description: Status: draft → submitted → (approved | rejected). Rejected → draft. Approved → paid. Invalid transitions rejected. Permission: clerk submits, manager/admin approves.

FR07.name: Approval Actions with Permission Checks
FR07.description: Clerk can create/submit. Manager+ can approve/reject. Admin can do all. Viewer read-only. Server-side enforcement.

FR08.name: Audit Log
FR08.description: All key actions logged: invoice create/update/delete, status changes, approval actions. Append-only. Filterable by user, action, date range.

FR09.name: Dashboard / Report Summary
FR09.description: Dashboard shows: total invoices this month, total amount, pending approvals, paid vs unpaid breakdown. Aggregated from database.

FR10.name: Search / Filter / Sort
FR10.description: Filter invoices by status, customer, date range. Search by invoice number or customer name. Sort by date, amount, status.

FR11.name: CSV Export
FR11.description: Export invoice list to CSV with deterministic columns: invoice_number, customer, date, status, subtotal, tax, grand_total.

FR12.name: Validation and Error Handling
FR12.description: Validate: quantity > 0, unit_price >= 0, tax_rate 0-100, required fields, future dates. Meaningful error messages.

FR13.name: Seed / Sample Data
FR13.description: Seed data: 2-3 users with different roles, 3-5 customers, 3-5 invoices with line items in various statuses.

FR14.name: UI Pages
FR14.description: Login, Dashboard, Customer List, Invoice List, Invoice Detail (with line items + approval buttons), Audit Log. Loading/empty/error states.

FR15.name: API Contract
FR15.description: RESTful API. Consistent request/response/error shapes. Pagination on list endpoints.

FR16.name: Tests and Documentation
FR16.description: Unit/integration tests with real assertions. README with setup/run/test. No fake tests. No placeholder implementations.

nonFunctionalRequirements.NFR02: Persistence abstraction — database layer separated from business logic
nonFunctionalRequirements.NFR03: Deterministic test/verification — tests produce repeatable results
nonFunctionalRequirements.NFR04: No fake tests — all tests have real assertions
nonFunctionalRequirements.NFR05: No placeholder-only implementation — every endpoint returns real data
nonFunctionalRequirements.NFR07: Financial calculations verified server-side — not client-only

unitTests: Status workflow: valid and invalid transitions
Permission: clerk cannot approve, manager can
integrationTests: Auth flow: register → login → protected endpoint
